subject: Post-demo: Trial acceptance checklist, integration commitments and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Park <ellie.park@vanguardai.com>, Sam Khan <sam.khan@vanguardai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: Trial acceptance checklist, integration commitments and next steps

Hi Ellie / Sam —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and the proposed acceptance & integration plan so we have alignment before the trial kicks off:

1) Trial scope (30 days):
   - Inference endpoints for document-classification and extractive Q&A (two routes).
   - Streaming enabled for Q&A route (client-side streaming + server-sent tokens).
   - Tool calling enabled for a single internal lookup service (product metadata).

2) Success criteria (what VanguardAI will validate):
   - Average 95th percentile latency <= 250ms for classification (batch: 8 reqs).
   - Streaming QPS support of 40 concurrent streams with end-to-end latency < 600ms for first token.
   - Accuracy: extractive QA F1 >= 0.78 on the provided eval set.
   - No PII leakage in 5 sampled sessions (we’ll provide redaction instrumentation).

3) Tech deliverables from Redwood (what we'll provide):
   - SDK snippets for Node/Python showing streaming client, example tool-calling hook, and recommended batching config. (See attached MAP + SOW)
   - Reference API routes: /v1/generate (classification), /v1/stream-qa (streaming + tool-calling).
   - A short config file for quantization/profile we recommend for the trial workload.

4) Ownership & SLAs during trial:
   - Redwood PM: Marissa Cole — overall trial lead, success criteria owner.
   - Redwood Solutions Eng: Ben Carter — integration owner (SDK, tool-calling wiring, streaming tests).
   - VanguardAI Eng lead: TBD (please assign).

5) Timeline (proposed):
   - Dec 17: Sign MAP and confirm Eng lead.
   - Dec 20–22: Integration sprint (wiring SDK + tool calls, basic smoke tests).
   - Jan 5: Trial start (30 days).
   - Jan 20: Mid-trial check-in (metric snapshot).
   - Feb 4: Trial closeout / decision.

Action items:
   - Ellie/Sam: confirm acceptance criteria and share your QA eval set by EOD Wed (12/16).
   - VanguardAI: assign an Eng lead we should loop in (cc Ben).
   - Redwood: we’ll share the MAP and SOW drafts (attached) and a short integration guide.

I’ve attached a Mutual Action Plan and a draft SOW. If this looks good I’ll convert the MAP to a shared spreadsheet and send a DocuSign for signatures.

Thanks — excited to get this running.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Director
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. That aligns with what we discussed. A couple quick clarifications from our side before we sign:

- For the streaming route, can you confirm the recommended websocket keepalive and max chunk size in the Node SDK? We want to match client-side settings.
- For tool calling: does Redwood require a specific serialization format for the tool response (json-lines vs json)? Sam asked about error semantics if the tool is slow.
- Success criteria: can we add a non-functional pass/fail for throughput under 95th percentile token cost? We are cost-sensitive and would like a simple cost benchmark.

I’ll bring our Eng lead (Sam) into the thread for technical Qs; I’m aiming to confirm sign-off by 12/17.

Best,
Ellie

Thanks Ellie — answers inline below, + attachments and a short tech checklist.

- Streaming websocket settings: we recommend keepalive 25s, max chunk ~8KB (Node SDK example attached). These are conservative defaults that we tuned for mobile clients.
- Tool calling serialization: use JSON-Lines for streaming tool responses; synchronous tool responses can be plain JSON. We include sample error-handling semantics in the SDK snippet (retry on 5xx, 30s tool-timeout default).
- Cost benchmark: added as a line item in the MAP — target: token-cost per 1k queries <= $X (we’ll fill with your workload after initial run).

Attached: VanguardAI_MutualActionPlan.xlsx (with the acceptance rows filled), RDW_SOW_draft_v1.docx (commercials placeholder), and a short integration-guide.md excerpt pasted below.

>>>> Integration checklist (technical) — Redwood deliverables
- /v1/generate (POST) — classification: accepts batch array of inputs, return array of labels + score. Recommended batch size 8.
- /v1/stream-qa (websocket/HTTP stream) — streaming tokens + tool-calling hook. Client opens stream, sends context + query; server pushes tokens as they’re generated.
- Tool-calling hook: on tool_request event Redwood will POST to your callback endpoint at /vanguardai/tool-callback with content-type: application/x-ndjson.
- Auth: Bearer token; we’ll provide trial tokens scoped to endpoints.

Can Ben and Karthik confirm engineering availability for the integration sprint (Dec 20–22)? I’ll wait on your QA eval set to lock the cost benchmark.

—
Marissa
